name: Unwind & Play Mah Jongg Club of Rockingham County
notes: Listed in the Mahjong 4 Friends teacher directory (Stoneville, NC — Rockingham County is North of Greensboro. I teach in the Triad Area that includes Greensboro, High Point, and Winston-Salem. I also teach in south side Virginia that includes Danville and Martinsville); the teacher's own site has not been checked. Directory note: "I am an experienced American Mah Jongg teacher for beginner, strategy, and tournament play. "Have tiles will travel" is my motto.
